cases.query: The report lists a few values but misses the main trend and offers too little comparison.
The report identifies major trends and compares the most important figures with enough supporting data.
The sequence of ideas is uneven and links between sentences are often mechanical.
Information moves logically between clear sections, although a few linking expressions are awkward.
Repeated everyday terms and unsuitable word choices restrict the precision of the report.
The report uses a varied, mostly precise vocabulary, with occasional errors in less familiar expressions.
Simple clauses dominate the report and frequent grammar mistakes make parts difficult to follow.
The report uses different sentence patterns, including complex clauses, and many sentences are accurate.
The essay takes a position but leaves one part of the question unanswered and explanations are too thin.
The essay answers the whole question, sustains an opinion and develops supporting arguments with examples.
The argument jumps between points and paragraph boundaries do not consistently separate ideas.
The argument follows a clear sequence with focused paragraphs and mostly effective connections.
The writer repeats common vocabulary, with frequent word-choice and spelling problems.
The writer uses a broad vocabulary to express distinctions, with occasional awkward collocations.
The essay relies heavily on short sentences, while errors in longer sentences sometimes obscure the point.
The writer combines sentence structures flexibly and produces many correct sentences, with a few grammar errors.
